promotion.category: AI intelligent document and task platform

user_supplied_claims.provenance: user-provided as 'free token'; wording intentionally avoids unlimited/permanent-free implication

hotspot.name: Aura Farming battles
hotspot.source_note: Street/social battles where participants compete through poses, gestures and recognizable meme performance to project charisma and style.

creative_directive.in_asset_cta_policy: no URL or QR; product attribution only at the payoff

strategy.category_default: Trying an AI-agent workflow often feels like a developer project before useful work begins: setup, environments, keys, deployment and billing decisions.
strategy.deleted_constraint: Remove the requirement to become the deployment engineer before starting the actual task.
strategy.new_competition_axis: time-to-first-use and creative/workflow output instead of setup ceremony
strategy.bridge: Turn the current Aura Farming battle format into a developer setup battle: one side farms aura by stacking setup rituals; InkClawAgent wins by bringing only the task and immediately working.

concept.title: 2026 Agent 开发 Aura Farming 大赛
concept.layout: continuous 9:16 social short: one original anonymous street-battle location, camera and character continuity instead of poster panels or slideshow cuts

opening.visual: camera follows an anonymous developer entering the battle overloaded with boxes/cards labeled Docker, 环境变量, API Key, Deploy, 依赖, Token 账单
opening.caption: 先把开发环境叠满
opening.sound: crowd murmur, shoe scrape, box thuds, comic bass plucks

escalation.visual: the setup stack becomes an absurd aura performance; the developer keeps posing while the actual task remains untouched
escalation.caption: AURA 12
escalation.sound: cheap sports-broadcast stings and exaggerated stacking impacts

reversal.visual: camera pans in the same space to a relaxed anonymous creator opening InkClawAgent; Research, Write, Review and Code task lights begin moving immediately
reversal.caption: 打开 → 直接干活
reversal.sound: one clean trigger hit followed by four light agent pop sounds

payoff.visual: the overloaded competitor is still arranging setup props while the creator is already working; the score flips as a joke, not a factual benchmark
payoff.caption: AURA 999

concept.product_explainer: InkClawAgent = 打开就用的多 Agent 工作台
concept.use_cases: 长文创作 · 文档审阅 · Review/改写 · Coding Assist

creative_review.instant_comprehension: high: setup ceremony versus immediate useful work reads through action before the text finishes
creative_review.natural_linkage: high: aura farming maps directly to performative setup ceremony versus useful work
creative_review.product_centrality: high: the joke depends on InkClawAgent removing setup friction
creative_review.surprise: high: developer tooling ceremony becomes an aura battle
creative_review.ownability: medium-high: strengthened by specific no-deploy/low-barrier/free-token/multi-agent product claims
creative_review.evidence_safety: use user-provided product claims without adding unlimited/permanent-free or superiority claims; aura score is unmistakable subjective satire
creative_review.original_execution: use anonymous original characters and original staging; do not reproduce real viral participants or protected meme frames

render_notes.visual_style: internet-native documentary comedy with intentionally scrappy low-budget broadcast energy, original anonymous characters and one continuous physical location
render_notes.motion_rule: use camera follow, pan, reaction timing, foreground occlusion and action continuity; do not present still-image slides with hard cuts pretending to be video
render_notes.audio_rule: environment bed + character dialogue + prop impacts + comic music; music ducks under dialogue and payoff sound effects
render_notes.distribution_rule: meme first, attribution second; no in-asset URL, QR code or '立即体验' CTA unless a later conversion brief explicitly requires it
avoid: URL or QR code inside the social asset
claims of unlimited or permanent free tokens
